welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Pindura mibvunzo mishomanana pamusoro pezviratidzo zvako. Chiremba wako anoongorora zvose usati wasangana.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Izvi zvinobatanidza kushanya kwako nerondedzero yako.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Ndinokutendai Ndichabvunza mibvunzo mishoma nokukurumidza pamusoro {complaint} dzenyu.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Ndinokutendai Ndichabvunza mibvunzo mishoma nokukurumidza pamusoro chii chakaita kuti iwe kupinda.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Nyora mhinduro, kana kuti tinya zano riri pamusoro apa

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Dzvanya chinhu chipi nechipi kuti uchigadzirise usati watumira.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Kana zviratidzo zvako zvikava zvakakomba kana kuti zvichiwedzera kuipa iye zvino, usamirira fonera masevhisi ekukurumidzira.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Zviratidzo zvenyu zvinoratidza chimwe chinhu chinofanira kuonekwa nokukurumidza.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Chikwata chemakiriniki chinogamuchira nhoroondo yako yakarongeka pakarepo.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Kana zvikawedzera kuipa, kurumidza kuita chimwe chinhu

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Kuwedzera kwakanyanya kana kuti kamwe kamwe dana masevhisi ekukurumidzira pakarepo.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Uku ndiko kufungidzira kwokukurumidzira, kwete kuongororwa. Chiremba ndiye anoita chisarudzo chokupedzisira.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Vanochengeta marekodhi ako, saka boka rako rokutarisira rinoona nhoroondo yako yose pakarepo.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Nhoroondo yako iri nechikwata chevanotarisira, tichakuzivisa pakarepo kana chiremba akaivhura.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Kana zvinhu zvichiwedzera kuipa, ita chimwe chinhu iye zvino.

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Kana zviratidzo zvako zvikava zvakakomba kana kuti zvangowedzera kuipa fonera masevhisi ekukurumidzira iye zvino kana kuti enda kudhipatimendi rekukurumidzira riri pedyo.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Takanyora nyaya yako sechinhu chinonyanya kukosheswa kuitira kuti timu yevashandi vazive.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Chiremba ari kuongorora mharidzo yenyu, tichakuudzai nezvayo.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Pindura mibvunzo mishomanana pamusoro pokuti wave sei kubva pakushanya kwako.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Mamiriro ako ezvinhu akaenzana sei neaiva nawo kare?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Pane chimwe chinhu chaungada kutiudza here?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Tinofara kuti uri kunzwa zviri nani

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Tichaongororazve {next} kuti tive nechokwadi chokuti uchiri kuvandudzika.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Zviratidzo zvako zvinoratidza kuti pane chimwe chinhu chinoda kutarisirwa nokukurumidza.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Kutevera uku hakuchawanikwi. Pinda kuti uone zvauri kuita pari zvino.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Gadzira account yemahara kuti uone kushanya uku uye usapfuudza kodhi nguva inotevera.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Tichatumira kodhi yechinguva chimwe chete hapana password yekuyeuka.

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Pinda foni yako kana kuti email uye tichakutumira kodhi yekupinda.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Nhoroondo yako yakabatana nemarekodhi echipatara chako

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Handina kukwanisa kutumira kodhi. edza zvakare.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Network kukanganisa. Ongorora kubatana kwako uye edza zvakare.

errResendFailed.translation: Handina kukwanisa kutumira zvakare. Edza zvakare.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Nokuda kwokuchengeteka kwako uye kudzivirira mashoko evarwere, wakanyoreswa pashure penguva yokusaita basa.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Kukurukurirana kunonzwika muapp iyi · nhamba yako yefoni haimbogoverwi.

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Sarudza kuti ndiani anokufonera, uye kuti zvinonzwika sei.

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Mhoroi Jordan, inguva yokudya kwako kwemanheru...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Hapana mafoni 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · anodzokera kune chiziviso

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Mutsetse wako wekutarisira unoramba uchishanda pindazve kuti utarise mafoni uye zviyeuchidzo.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Kufona kwezwi kwakavharidzirwa · WebRTC · nhamba yako haimbogoverwi

callActiveLive.translation: MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU MABHUKU

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Imi chete uye {hospital} munogona kuona izvi. Tinya kushanya kuti muverenge pfupiso yakagoverwa nemi.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Hapana kutarisira kunoda kushanyirwa uku parizvino.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Kana zviratidzo zvako zvadzoka kana kuti zvikaipisisa, tsvaka rubatsiro rwokukurumidzira pakarepo.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Zvimwe kushanya uku kwabviswa, kana kuti chinongedzo chacho hachisisiri kushanda. Dzokai kuti muone nhoroondo yenyu yakazara.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Gadza mashoko ako. Chiremba wako anoona zvachangobva kuitika.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Inoshandura mutauro wechidzitiro chimwe nechimwe pakarepo.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Haikwanisi kukopa - sarudza uye kukopa nemaoko

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Zita renyu, mashoko enyu okuonana, uye mhinduro dzenyu dzemashoko akasununguka zvinobviswa chero chinhu chipi zvacho chisati chabuda muchipatara chenyu.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Bvumira mashoko asina kuzivikanwa kuti awedzere kutarisirwa kwevanhu vose. Unogona kuchinja izvi chero nguva.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Bvisai nguva dzose account yenyu nemashoko enyu okuonana. Nhoroondo yenyu yokurapwa inochengetwa nechipatara chenyu sezvinodiwa nomutemo.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Kumbira kopi yemashoko enyu okushanya, mishonga yenyu, uye nhoroondo dzenyu dzokushanyirwa.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Izvi zvinobvisa zvachose account yako nemashoko okuonana. Chipatara chako chinochengetedza nhoroondo yako yebasa rokutarisira sezvinodiwa nomutemo. Izvi hazvigoni kuitwa.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Chikwata chako chokutarisira chichabvumirana newe neindaneti mumaawa 72, uye rutsigiro rwenyu rucharamba ruchishanda kusvikira panguva iyoyo.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Sarudza chimiro uye kukumbira kutengeswa kwako. Tichaigadzirira uye kutumira kubatana kwakachengeteka kune email yako yakanyoreswa.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Tichatumira tsamba yakachengeteka yekubatanidza kukero yako yakanyoreswa mukati memaawa 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Hapana faira rinotorwa pasi pano - zvinyorwa zvako zvinotumirwa zvakachengeteka kune email yako yakanyoreswa.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Nyora tsamba yekukoka yakatumirwa kuchipatara chako, kana kuongorora kodhi yavo yeQR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Izvozvo hazvioneki sechinhu cheTriavi chinokoka kana kuti kodhi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Kodhi yemakiriniki inoshanda inokutungamirira zvakananga kumashoko ako.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Kodhi yekiriniki inoshanda inokutungamirira zvakananga kumashoko ako. Dev: tinya Simulate kodhi yakaonekwa kuti uongorore kuyerera.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Ipa mvumo yekamera mumagariro ebrowser yako, kana kuti pinda chinongedzo chekukoka nemaoko.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Hapana kamera yakaonekwa. Pinda chinongedzo chekukoka icho chipatara chako chakatumira panzvimbo pacho.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Kamera haisipo iye zvino. Pinda chibvumirano chokukoka nemaoko.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Kunze kwepaIndaneti? Kuratidza chinyorwa chebvunzurudzo chakaponeswa
